title: Smoke 17 - Retrieve Cache Dedupe
description: Three defines reference the same [Observation] retrieve. Under BUG-116 this produced 3+ retrieve trace rows because debug mode evaluated each expression in a separate engine.evaluate() call. After the fix, all three share the batch eval's retrieve cache and only 1 row appears.
cqlContent:
library "Smoke17RetrieveDedupe" version '1.0.0'

using FHIR version '4.0.1'

context Patient

define "AllObservations":
  [Observation]

define "HasAnyObservation":
  exists("AllObservations")

define "ObservationCount":
  Count("AllObservations")

define "Card":
  Tuple {
    summary: 'Observation count: ' + ToString("ObservationCount"),
    detail: 'if HasAnyObservation: ' + ToString("HasAnyObservation"),
    indicator: 'info',
    sourceLabel: 'Smoke 17'
  }
